name: resource_group_kms_key
description: Registers an existing, customer-managed KMS key against a duploai_resource_group. Downstream resources (e.g. duploai_ecr, duploai_aws_efs, duploai_elasticache, duploai_node_group) can then reference the key via their own kms_key_id attribute; the backend resolves it against this registry. Registering a key does not grant the resource group's IAM role any permissions on it — the key's own key policy must already trust the account/role.

attributes.name: workspace_id
attributes.description: ID of the workspace that owns the parent resource group.

attributes.name: resource_group_id
attributes.description: ID of the duploai_resource_group to register this key against.

attributes.name: key_name
attributes.description: Friendly label for this key registration.

attributes.name: key_arn
attributes.description: ARN of the existing customer-managed KMS key. Its key policy must already grant access to this resource group's account/role — registering it here does not modify the key's policy.

attributes.name: key_id
attributes.description: Raw AWS KMS key ID, if it differs from what can be derived from key_arn. Some downstream resources accept either key_id or key_arn to reference this registration.

attributes.name: key_entry_id
attributes.description: This registration's own backend record ID (distinct from key_id, which is the AWS KMS key's ID).
